text: Oh, hello again... What? A dragon?\nI think it might be somewhere around here.
The monsters around this city are transforming\nthese days.
Also, they've got much fiercer...\nLooks like the dragon's miasma is the cause...
You saw the weird plant-like monsters\non your way, didn't ya?\nIt shows the dragon's miasma is getting stronger.
We were asked to get rid of the monsters and to\ninvestigate how the miasma is spreading...
By the way, what brought you here?\n...You're such a happy-go-lucky guy.\nWhat'll you do if the dragon really...
Oh, I haven't told you how to use holy gems...
Huh? Somebody already told you? Cule peddlers?\nAlright then. Just make use of them.
But if the dragon is too strong, just run.\nWhile there is life, there is hope...\nKeep your guard up.
